newsitem.title: USA: FORECAST-U.S. durables the focal point Oct 21 week.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-U.S. durables the focal point Oct 21 week.

text.p: A sparse economic calendar will leave next Friday's durable goods report alone in the spotlight, said economists in a Reuters poll.
Although durables is a volatile indicator, experts still watch it because it often foreshadows growth trends, said Carol Stone, senior economist at Nomura Securities International Inc.
"It's the beginning of the production process ... it's a forerunner of the strength of economic activity," she said.

On average, 24 experts forecast orders for durable goods rose 2.0 percent in September, up from a 3.2 percent decline in August. Excluding defense, economists forecast orders rose 1.3 percent after a 3.6 percent drop the previous month.
"Durables are typically volatile," noted Dan Seto, senior economist at Nikko Securities Co International Inc.
"Last month we had a (3.2 percent) drop, so we think the underlying trend is upward," Seto said.
That may have something to with "an aircraft phenomenon," said Nomura's Stone, adding that aircraft orders "are erratic from month-to-month."
